items.title: Third-Party Risk Fundamentals
items.summary: Introduces third-party risk, lifecycle and governance considerations.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Introduces third-party risk, lifecycle and governance considerations. This lesson focuses on practical understanding, decision-making and evidence-based GRC practice.

sections.heading: Key concepts
sections.body: Core concepts for third-party risk fundamentals are explained in plain language, with emphasis on roles, controls, risks and expected outcomes in an enterprise context.

sections.heading: Application
sections.body: Learners should be able to apply the concepts to realistic scenarios, justify decisions, and recognise common gaps or weaknesses.

examples.title: Applying Third-Party Risk Fundamentals
examples.context: A team must address third-party risk fundamentals in a business scenario with limited time and resources.
examples.outcome: A risk-informed, documented decision with clear ownership and follow-up actions.

practicalExercise.title: Exercise: Third-Party Risk Fundamentals
practicalExercise.brief: Apply the lesson to a fictional organisation facing challenges related to third-party risk fundamentals.
practicalExercise.deliverable: A short action plan with rationale.
